newsitem.title: USA: Gabelli group lifts Cablevision stake.
newsitem.headline: Gabelli group lifts Cablevision stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Monday it raised its stake in Cablevision Systems Corp to the equivalent of 20.64 percent or 2,742,765 class A common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought a net of 151,400 common shares of Cablevision between October 7 and 18 at prices ranging from $34.00 to $41.1355 a share.

The group said its stake includes 27,565 class A common shares it will receive on conversion of preferred shares of Cablevision that it holds. The group previously held the equivalent of 19.61 percent of Cablevision's class A common shares outstanding.
